name: Aida Engineering, Ltd.
summary: Aida Engineering, Ltd. manufactures and sells press machines, auto-processing lines, industrial robots, auto-conveyers, and dies in Japan, China, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. It offers general-purpose servo, mid-size and large servo, precision forming, general-purpose, mid-size and large, high-speed automatic, and cold forging presses, as well as transfer equipment, coil feeders, and tooling dies. The company also provides troubleshooting and spare parts, retrofit and modernization, routine inspection, and overhaul and machine relocation services.
